newsitem.title: GREECE: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY FED'N WANTS END TO STATE MONOPOLIES.
newsitem.headline: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY FED'N WANTS END TO STATE MONOPOLIES.

text.p: The Hellenic Federation of Information Technology Companies (SEPE) is satisfied with the election outcome of a strong government and hopes it will meet the technological challenges of the 21st century, it said.
SEPE said the country's development depended to a great extent on the modernisation of its infrastructure, education and public administration.
"SEPE is ready to assist the new government in achieving the needed technological leaps," it said in a statement.
"SEPE will strive to see Greece adopt outsourcing policies, end state monopolies and free up market forces so that the country catches up with the technological levels of other EU countries."
